title: Test 5 — Bring 2 cells close nearby
agent_prompt: These cells contain an optogenetic actuator that allows to induce directed migration upon stimulation with blue light. The channel phase-contrast is used for imaging, and the channel stimulation is used to stimulate the cells. For all cells in the FOV, stimulate the cells so that always two cells are assembled in a cluster, while maximising the distance between the clusters Stimulate the cells for 3 minutes and take a photo every 15 seconds. Save the photos to a folder and save the cell trajectories to a CSV file with the following format: cell_id, stimulation_time, x-position, y-position. At the end of the experiment, display the images and trajectories in the Napari GUI. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: CSV file with the trajectories at each stimulation
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
